The Ghana Revenue Authority says its digital VAT system will not increase prices for existing subscribers.

Tax officials clarified that 92 foreign platforms already remit the 20 per cent statutory tax.
About 100 newly identified digital platforms will be added to the collection system gradually.
The rollout affects streaming and online services, but excludes imported physical goods.

The Ghana Revenue Authority has clarified that its new digital VAT collection framework will not add a fresh 20 per cent tax to online subscriptions. Commissioner-General Anthony Kwasi Sarpong explained that prices for platforms already charging the tax, such as Netflix and Spotify, will remain unchanged. However, about 100 foreign providers not previously charging VAT will be brought into compliance progressively.
